datasets.title: OceanCV annotated seep transect
datasets.attribution: OceanCV / OOI / University of Washington / NSF, Carter (2025)
datasets.license: MIT for the two publisher dataset repositories
datasets.sampling: First eight annotation exports at 32-frame intervals, independent of label content or model performance. Exact t = source frame number / 29.

datasets.title: MBARI DeepSea-MOT Benthic Simple
datasets.attribution: Barnard, Liu, Walz, Schlining, Jacobsen Stout and Lundsten / MBARI (2025)
datasets.sampling: The first eight systematic observations from the Benthic Simple sequence, one-based publisher frame IDs 1 through 421, spaced by 60. Relative time at nominal 60000/1001 fps. The original XML basename identifies Ventana V4289 and gives a recording timestamp label of 2020-07-29T18:50:27Z. The excerpt offset within the dive recording is undocumented; absolute UTC is left unset.

protocol: Frames and sources fixed before reading predictions. OOI frames are development data from Ecotype training/validation. MBARI Benthic Simple is held out of this trial; overlap with upstream model pretraining is unverified. Distances or surveyed areas are unavailable.
